thread:
anna_support: Heads-up — customer 'edu-platform' reported a regression after bumping python SDK to 1.12. Calls that used to succeed to Client.create(project='edu123', ...) now raise TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'project'. They say it started after the SDK auto-updated and it caused retry storms and duplicate billing charges. :grimacing:
zach_engineer: ouch. do we have a stacktrace or request_id from their logs?
anna_support: pasted minimal stack from their worker log and the failing call: 
````
TypeError: Client.create() got an unexpected keyword argument 'project'
  File "/app/task.py", line 42, in run_job
    client.create(prompt, project='edu123')
````
request id from their dashboard: r-cust-9a8b
maria_pm: did we intentionally remove project kwarg in 1.12? I thought we aliased it.
zach_engineer: we changed the internal param to 'scope' in 1.12 to avoid confusion, but forgot to keep the compatibility alias. that's on me.
anna_support: customer asks for immediate workaround and pin recommendation. they are on a tight billing window.
kevin_infra: immediate mitigation: ask them to pin to 1.11.3 and set a retry header to avoid duplicate processing while we patch. pip command: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.11.3`
zach_engineer: also advise them to set REDWOOD_RETRY_ONCE=1 (temporary env flag we exposed last year) to minimize duplicate attempts.
maria_pm: can we do a quick patch release that restores the alias? patch semantics: accept both project and scope, deprecation warning for project. target micro release 1.12.1.
zach_engineer: creating issue RN-4587, will push fix + unit test for param alias. aiming for release in next 2 business days.
anna_support: I sent the customer repro steps and the pin + env workaround. they also asked for a signed statement for charge reversal if duplicates happened — legal already looped in.
kevin_infra: for the billing side, tag the requests with idempotency-key when possible. if they used no idempotency it explains dup charges. we should recommend idempotency in docs and add quick guidance in support reply.
zach_engineer: minimal code snippet to migrate: 
````python
# old (works on <=1.11.x)
client.create(prompt, project='edu123')
# new (1.12+)
client.create(prompt, scope='edu123')
# temporary compatibility patch in 1.12.1 will accept project= as alias with a DeprecationWarning
````
anna_support: customer confirmed pin works locally. they asked how to detect other affected customers — can we run telemetry?
kevin_infra: I'll run a query for api_client calls containing 'project=' usage in recent weeks (internal logs) and report back. should catch most.
maria_pm: add a short blurb in the changelog and a highlighted note in release notes so users know about param rename and pin guidance.
zach_engineer: also adding an integration test for retries + idempotency so we don't regress.
deploy_bot: release pipeline 1.12.1 scheduled — waiting for CI ✅
anna_support: thanks team. I'll follow up with the customer thread: include pip pin, REDWOOD_RETRY_ONCE env, migration snippet, and ETA for patch 1.12.1. :thumbsup:
kevin_infra: follow-up: found ~12 orgs using project= calls in last 30d. i'll share the list with Support to proactively reach out.
anna_support: perfect — closing this thread once 1.12.1 is out and customers notified.
